  {"step": 9, "file": "Packet++/src/SomeIpSdLayer.cpp", "function": "SomeIpSdLayer::countOptions", "line": 647, "var": "lenOptions", "code": "size_t lenOptions = getLenOptions()", "note": "lenOptions=1 read from bytes at offset 24-27; dataLen=28 so this read is in bounds"},
  {"step": 10, "file": "Packet++/src/SomeIpSdLayer.cpp", "function": "SomeIpSdLayer::countOptions", "line": 651, "var": "m_Data + offsetOption + len", "code": "uint32_t lenOption = be16toh(*((uint16_t *)(m_Data + offsetOption + len))) + 3 * sizeof(uint8_t)", "note": "HEAP-BUFFER-OVERFLOW READ 2: reads 2 bytes at offset 28+0=28, but dataLen is only 28 bytes (valid range 0-27), causing out-of-bounds read"}
